description: On-chain .agent name registry and marketplace for AI agents on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.32). An admin initialises protocol config (treasury, fee tiers, registration period); later instructions register, stake, list and trade names in $NAIM, SOL or USDC.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration on the Blockchains/naim-program fork. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; fixes are offered upstream as ordinary pull requests and acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (initialize, init_token_config, register_name)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/naim/
QA: devnet proof of initialize, init_token_config, register_name campus-scout, InvalidConfig, a rejected second initialize, and NameAlreadyRegistered
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Stand up init_token_config with a $NAIM mint and exercise register_name, plus a list/buy fixture
